title: Every Melody Has Been Copyrighted (and they're all on this hard drive)
summary: Adam Neely interviews Damien Riehl and Noah Rubin about their project to generate and copyright every possible melody as MIDI. The video explains their reasoning and how it bears on music copyright lawsuits.
why: It is the go-to explainer whenever HN discusses brute-forcing melodies, copyright, or AI-generated content, since it features the project's creators.

quote.text: Strongly recommend watching that video! Excellent info.
